question: Should the dashboard widget gallery support raw URL installs, ClawHub/package-backed installs, or stay out of bundled OpenClaw until the widget substrate and trust model are settled?
rationale: This adds a new distribution and untrusted browser-code install surface, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary or decide whether arbitrary URL installs belong in bundled OpenClaw.

options.title: Design a ClawHub-backed gallery first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the settled dashboard substrate to install widgets through package/trust metadata plus explicit operator approval.

options.title: Allow raw URL installs with strict gates
options.body: Permit install-from-URL only after maintainers define validation, provenance, sandbox, storage, update, and rollback requirements.

options.title: Move widget distribution outside core
options.body: Defer bundled gallery work and ask for widget distribution to start as an external plugin or ClawHub experiment.

recommendation.title: Design a ClawHub-backed gallery first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the settled dashboard substrate to install widgets through package/trust metadata plus explicit operator approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current Control UI plugin-tab precedent and is the strongest history-backed decision owner for whether this becomes a bundled dashboard product surface.
